'''November 1999 Boca Raton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boca Raton, Florida on 21 November 1999. [[David Irvine]] won it. It is known from Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d121">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-23-boca-raton-florida-11-21-99d121/ boca-raton-florida-11-21-99], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 23 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-23-boca-raton-florida-11-21-99d121/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 November 1999
* '''Site:''' Boca Raton, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[David Irvine]]

* [[Andrew Ledwith Boca Raton Florida 11-21-99 (tournament report)]] — by [[Andrew Ledwith]], 5th, 2–2
* [[Mike Fitzgerald 11-22-99 Boca Raton Florida Back In Saddle (tournament report)]] — by [[Michael Fitzgerald]], 2nd, 3–1

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Andrew Ledwith says winner David Irvine played 'LS Speeder Ops and some kind of ISB'; Mike Fitzgerald, who played Irvine's Ralltiir Ops deck in round 1, says Irvine went undefeated with 'ROps and Bothan Ops'.<ref name="tr-d121" />
* Mike Fitzgerald says David Irvine went undefeated with 'ROps and Bothan Ops'; Andrew Ledwith's report of the same event says Irvine played 'LS Speeder Ops and some kind of ISB'. Fitzgerald's report is dated 11-22-99 and Ledwith's 11-21-99.<ref name="tr-d125" />
